confounded_expert_demos.description: Offline control from confounded demonstrations: 32 held-out confounded MDP instances, each with 10,000 logged transitions from a capable demonstrator that sees a hidden context the learner cannot observe (10% uniformly random logged actions). Policies are scored by exact interventional return, normalised per instance so that the uniform-random policy is 0 and the demonstrator is 1 (the paper's Table 1 normalisation).
confounded_expert_demos.notes: Scaled analogue of the paper's 12 masked-Atari games with the diamond demonstrator (Table 1). The paper's Atari numbers are kept under keys starting with '_' for context only; they are not on this gym's scale. Unprefixed results are this gym's measured hidden-test values (3 runs each).

normalized_mean_return.description: Mean over instances and runs of (policy return - random return) / (demonstrator return - random return); returns are exact expected interventional returns. Paper: Normalized Mean.

normalized_iqm_return.description: Interquartile mean of the same instance-run normalised returns (paper: Normalized IQM).

worst_decile_normalized_return.description: Mean of the lowest 10% of instance-run normalised returns. Constraint metric: the paper's claim is a policy that is safe in the worst case compatible with the data, so gains in the mean must not come from failing badly on some instances.

pervasive_confounding.description: Same task and scoring on 32 held-out instances where the demonstrator relies on the hidden context for more of its choices and only 5% of logged actions are uniformly random, so the logged action-outcome association is more biased and less of the action space is explored.
pervasive_confounding.notes: Scaled analogue of the setting where the paper's method recovers less of the demonstrator's performance (Appendix E / Table 2, sebulba demonstrator: normalised mean 0.55) and of the limitations in Appendix G. The paper's Table 2 numbers are kept under '_' keys for context only.

normalized_mean_return.description: Mean over instances and runs of (policy return - random return) / (demonstrator return - random return); exact expected interventional returns.

normalized_iqm_return.description: Interquartile mean of the instance-run normalised returns.

worst_decile_normalized_return.description: Mean of the lowest 10% of instance-run normalised returns (worst-case robustness constraint).
